question: What is the ratio of the total number of atoms in molecules with a positive label to the total number of atoms in molecules with a negative label?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

question: What is the label of the molecule with molecule_id 'TR004'?
sql: SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

question: What is the average reputation of users who have posted at least 10 questions?
sql: SELECT AVG(reputation) FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY owneruserid HAVING COUNT(owneruserid) >= 10)

question: What is the ratio of the number of molecules with at least one double bond to those with at least one single bond among molecules labeled as positive?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

question: How many users have more than 5000 upvotes and less than 1000 downvotes?
sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM users WHERE upvotes > 5000 AND downvotes < 1000

question: List all elements present in molecules labeled as positive.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

question: What is the total amount of loans issued in the year 2019?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM loan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2019

question: What is the proportion of transactions classified as 'PREVOD NA UCET' (transfer to another account)?
sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS transfer_percentage FROM trans AS T1

question: What is the maximum transaction amount for account number 505?
sql: SELECT MAX(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 505

question: Which users have both received more than 1000 upvotes and have more than 5000 views?
sql: SELECT id, displayname FROM users WHERE reputation > 2000 AND views > 1000

question: When was the last time a user named 'Alice' made a comment?
sql: SELECT MAX(T1.creationdate) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.userid = T2.id WHERE T2.displayname = 'Alice'

question: Is molecule TR012 a carcinogen?
sql: SELECT T.label FROM molecule AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR012'

question: Find the clients who have received more than 100000 transactions.
sql: SELECT T4.client_id FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id GROUP BY T4.client_id HAVING SUM(T1.amount) > 100000

question: What is the average number of atoms per molecule for molecules with a '+' label?
sql: SELECT AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' GROUP BY T2.molecule_id

question: Find the display names of users who have received exactly 10 votes on their posts.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.displayname FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.owneruserid INNER JOIN votes AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.postid GROUP BY T1.displayname HAVING COUNT(T3.id) = 10

question: How many molecules contain exactly three bonds?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 3)

question: List the bond IDs and their corresponding molecule labels, ordered by the number of heavy atoms involved in each bond.
sql: SELECT T2.bond_id, T1.label, COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.element != 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_heavy_atoms FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN connected AS L ON T2.bond_id = L.bond_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON L.atom_id = T3.atom_id OR L.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id GROUP BY T2.bond_id, T1.label ORDER BY num_heavy_atoms DESC

question: Identify the top 2 accounts with the largest balance difference between deposits and withdrawals.
sql: SELECT account_id, (MAX(balance) - MIN(balance)) AS balance_difference FROM trans GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY balance_difference DESC LIMIT 2

question: List all unique molecules that have both 'c' and 'cl' elements.
sql: SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element IN ('c', 'cl') GROUP BY T2.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) = 2

question: How many times did the user with ID 1000 comment on posts?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE userid = 1000

question: What is the percentage of transactions that are deposits?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trans

question: How many loans were taken out in the year 1997?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 1997

question: What is the proportion of accounts with a frequency of weekly statements among all accounts?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE')::float / COUNT(*)) AS proportion_weekly_statements FROM account

question: How many transactions of type 'VYDAJ' (withdrawal) were made by accounts in the 'Prague' district?
sql: SELECT COUNT(T3.trans_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T1.a2 = 'Prague' AND T3.type = 'VYDAJ'

question: Find the average reputation of users who have both the 'Teacher' and 'Editor' badges.
sql: SELECT AVG(U.Reputation) FROM users AS U WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges AS B1 WHERE B1.UserId = U.Id AND B1.Name = 'Teacher') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges AS B2 WHERE B2.UserId = U.Id AND B2.Name = 'Editor')

question: How many loans have been made to accounts in the district of Litomerice?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T3.a2 = 'Litomerice'

question: What is the average payment amount for loans that have been fully paid (status 'A')?
sql: SELECT AVG(payments) FROM loan WHERE status = 'A'

question: How many molecules have bonds involving atom 'TR000_1'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

question: What percentage of clients who own accounts are male?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.type = 'OWNER') * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)) AS percentage_male_owners FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id

question: What is the average reputation of users who have posted more than 10 posts?
sql: SELECT AVG(reputation) FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT owneruserid FROM posts GROUP BY owneruserid HAVING COUNT(owneruserid) > 10)

question: How many comments were made by users who have more than 1000 reputation points?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.userid = T2.id WHERE T2.reputation > 1000

question: List the elements of atoms involved in molecules that contain a triple bond and are labeled as carcinogenic.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.element FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T1.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T4.label = '+'

question: Find the latest activity date of users who have posted answers to questions.
sql: SELECT MAX(lasactivitydate) FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 2

question: What is the total number of transactions per month?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions FROM trans GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month

question: What is the ratio of posts with more than 100 views to posts with less than 100 views?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN viewcount > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / SUM(CASE WHEN viewcount <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM posts

question: How many cards were issued to the owner of account number 303?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id WHERE T2.account_id = 303 AND T2.type = 'OWNER'

question: What is the ratio of loans that are in the 'A' status to those in the 'B' status?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM loan

question: Identify molecules that have at least three different types of bonds.
sql: SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T2.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_type) >= 3

question: What is the percentage of accounts that have been active for over 10 years?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(date)) > 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM account

question: What is the percentage of atoms in molecule 'TR001' that are carbon atoms?
sql: WITH carbon_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_num FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001' AND element = 'c'), total_atoms AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_num FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001') SELECT CAST(carbon_count.carbon_num AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_atoms.total_num AS percentage_carbon FROM carbon_count, total_atoms

question: List the titles of posts with more than 1000 views.
sql: SELECT Title FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > 1000

question: How many different elements are used in molecules labeled as non-carcinogenic?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-'

question: Find the top 10 users with the highest reputation who have posted the most answers.
sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName, COUNT(T2.Id) AS AnswerCount, T1.Reputation FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T2.PostTypeId = 2 GROUP BY T1.DisplayName, T1.Reputation ORDER BY AnswerCount DESC, Reputation DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find the number of clients who are female and were born in 1960.
sql: SELECT COUNT(client_id) FROM client WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM birth_date) = 1960 AND gender = 'F'

question: What percentage of comments have a score between 3 and 5?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score BETWEEN 3 AND 5) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM comments

question: Find the title of the post with ID 12345.
sql: SELECT Title FROM posts WHERE Id = 12345

question: List the labels of molecules that have at least one bond of type '#' and another bond of type '='.
sql: SELECT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond AS T3 WHERE T3.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id AND T3.bond_type = '#') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bond AS T4 WHERE T4.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id AND T4.bond_type = '=')

question: What percentage of bonds in molecule 'TR000' are double bonds?
sql: WITH total_bonds AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'), double_bonds AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' AND bond_type = '=') SELECT CAST(double_bonds.count AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_bonds.total AS percentage_double_bonds FROM double_bonds, total_bonds

question: Find the sum of bounty amounts for all votes cast by users under the age of 20.
sql: SELECT SUM(votes.BountyAmount) FROM votes JOIN users ON votes.UserId = users.Id WHERE users.Age < 20

question: List all molecules that contain at least one carbon atom.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c'

question: What percentage of users have received the 'Teacher' badge?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN name = 'Teacher' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM badges

question: What is the ratio of transactions with a negative balance compared to those with a positive balance?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.balance < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.balance >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_positive_ratio FROM trans AS T1

question: Among molecules labeled as negative, what percentage have at least one single bond?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-'

question: What is the average balance of accounts that have been active for over 10 years?
sql: SELECT AVG(T1.balance) FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE, T2.date)) > 10

question: How many molecules have more than 50 atoms?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 50) AS T

question: What is the count of molecules that contain at least one double bond?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1 WHERE T1.bond_type = '='

question: Find the display name of the user with ID 11111.
sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE Id = 11111

question: Find the districts where the total amount of transactions involving the keyword 'POJISTNE' (insurance) exceeds $500,000 in 1998.
sql: SELECT T2.a2 FROM district AS T2 INNER JOIN account AS T1 ON T2.district_id = T1.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE TO_CHAR(CAST(T3.date AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '1998' AND T3.k_symbol LIKE '%POJISTNE%' GROUP BY T2.a2 HAVING SUM(T3.amount) > 500000

question: Identify the molecule with the most distinct bonded elements.
sql: SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id INNER JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id = T4.atom_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T4.element) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of comments have a positive score?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Score > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM comments AS T1

question: What is the percentage of molecules with more than 10 atoms that contain both oxygen and nitrogen atoms?
sql: WITH large_molecules AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 10), oxygen_and_nitrogen AS (SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM large_molecules AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element IN ('o', 'n') GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element) = 2) SELECT CAST(COUNT(oxygen_and_nitrogen.molecule_id) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(large_molecules.molecule_id) AS percentage_oxygen_and_nitrogen FROM large_molecules LEFT JOIN oxygen_and_nitrogen ON large_molecules.molecule_id = oxygen_and_nitrogen.molecule_id

question: Find the number of distinct bonds in molecule 'TR000'
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR000'

question: Which users have earned the 'Scholar' badge in 2012?
sql: SELECT u.displayname FROM users AS u JOIN badges AS b ON u.id = b.userid WHERE b.name = 'Scholar' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.date) = 2012

question: What proportion of posts have a score less than -5?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score < -5) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM posts

question: Find the maximum view count among posts that have been linked to by exactly 5 other posts.
sql: SELECT MAX(viewcount) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postlinks AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.postid WHERE T2.relatedpostid IN (SELECT id FROM posts GROUP BY id HAVING COUNT(*) = 5)

question: Calculate the sum of all bond types, counting each occurrence.
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_bonds FROM bond

question: What is the total number of votes cast on posts by users who have more than 1000 reputation points?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.userid = T2.id

question: Find the molecule IDs of molecules that have both a single bond and a double bond.
sql: SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY T2.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_type) = 2

question: How many votes were cast on posts by users under the age of 25?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.userid = T2.id WHERE T2.age < 25

question: What is the average score of posts that have received exactly 3 votes?
sql: SELECT AVG(posts.Score) FROM posts JOIN votes ON posts.Id = votes.PostId WHERE votes.VoteTypeId = 2 GROUP BY posts.Id HAVING COUNT(votes.Id) = 3

question: How many unique clients have at least one loan and at least one transaction?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.client_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T4 ON T1.account_id = T4.account_id

question: How many accounts have been opened in each district with a weekly statement fee?
sql: SELECT T3.a2, COUNT(*) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' GROUP BY T3.district_id

question: What is the total amount of money loaned out to clients in Prague?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM loan AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T3.a3 = 'Prague'

question: List the top 10 questions with the highest number of answers.
sql: SELECT T1.Title, COUNT(T2.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount FROM posts AS T1 LEFT JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.ParentId = T2.Id WHERE T1.PostTypeId = 1 GROUP BY T1.Title ORDER BY AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: What proportion of badges named 'Teacher' are awarded to users with more than 1000 reputation?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Teacher') AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM badges WHERE userid IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE reputation > 1000)

question: Calculate the average transaction amount for each district where the transaction date was in 1998.
sql: SELECT T2.a2, AVG(T3.amount) as avg_transaction FROM district AS T2 INNER JOIN account AS T1 ON T2.district_id = T1.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T3.date) = 1998 GROUP BY T2.a2

question: Find the display names of users who have commented on the most posts.
sql: SELECT T4.DisplayName FROM comments AS T1 JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id JOIN users AS T4 ON T1.UserId = T4.Id GROUP BY T4.DisplayName ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Among posts with between 50 and 100 answers, what is the average view count per post?
sql: SELECT AVG(viewcount) FROM posts WHERE answercount BETWEEN 50 AND 100

question: Get the usernames of users who have received more than 50 upvotes.
sql: SELECT displayname FROM users WHERE upvotes > 50

question: How many comments were made on posts created after January 1, 2012?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.postid = T2.id WHERE T2.creaiondate > '2012-01-01'

question: How many bonds of type '-' are there in the database?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-'

question: What percentage of bonds in molecule TR000 are double bonds?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

question: What percentage of posts were created in the year 2013?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creaiondate) = 2013 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM posts

question: What is the total number of accounts opened in 1997?
sql: SELECT COUNT(account_id) FROM account WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 1997

question: What is the ratio of junior credit cards to total credit cards issued by the bank?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE type = 'junior')::float / COUNT(*)) AS junior_card_ratio FROM card

question: What is the total number of atoms in the molecule labeled '+'?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_atoms FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

question: Calculate the average reputation of users who have received more than 100 badges.
sql: SELECT AVG(reputation) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.userid GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100

question: What is the maximum amount paid in a single loan?
sql: SELECT MAX(payments) FROM loan

question: Find the titles of posts that have received both upvotes and downvotes.
sql: SELECT p.title FROM posts AS p JOIN votes AS v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE v.votetypeid = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM votes AS v2 WHERE v2.postid = p.id AND v2.votetypeid = 1)

question: List the top 10 users with the highest reputation who have received the 'Teacher' badge.
sql: SELECT T1.DisplayName, T1.Reputation FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Name = 'Teacher' ORDER BY T1.Reputation DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many loans have been taken out by clients over the age of 50?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client AS C JOIN disp AS D ON C.client_id = D.client_id JOIN account AS A ON D.account_id = A.account_id JOIN loan AS L ON A.account_id = L.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), C.birth_date)) > 50

question: How many molecules are there with a single bond?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T WHERE T.bond_type = '-'

question: How many distinct accounts have at least one transaction made by the owner of the account?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id) FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T2.type = 'OWNER'

question: Find the total number of votes cast on posts that were edited by users who have less than 100 reputation points.
sql: SELECT SUM(T4.VoteTypeId) FROM posthistory AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id INNER JOIN votes AS T4 ON T2.Id = T4.PostId INNER JOIN users AS U ON T1.UserId = U.Id WHERE U.Reputation < 100

question: What is the average bond length between atoms in molecules labeled as '-'?
sql: SELECT AVG(LENGTH(T1.atom_id) - LENGTH(T2.atom_id)) AS avg_bond_length FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T3.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T4.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T4.label = '-'

question: How many answers were posted by users with less than 50 reputation points?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.owneruserid = T2.id WHERE T2.reputation < 50 AND T1.posttypeid = 2

question: For molecules labeled '-', find the maximum number of consecutive carbon atoms they can have.
sql: WITH ccs AS (SELECT T2.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cc_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-' GROUP BY T2.molecule_id ORDER BY cc_count DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT MAX(cc_count) FROM ccs

question: Find the average score of posts that have been voted up by users who have more than 1000 reputation points.
sql: SELECT AVG(T2.score) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.postid = T2.id INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T1.userid = T3.id WHERE T3.reputation > 1000

question: Which molecules have more than five bonds?
sql: SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T2.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) > 5

question: Rank molecules based on the number of heavy atoms (non-hydrogen atoms).
sql: SELECT T1.molecule_id, T1.label, SUM(CASE WHEN T2.element != 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_heavy_atoms FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id, T1.label ORDER BY num_heavy_atoms DESC

question: Which months had the highest number of transactions involving credit cards?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T3.date) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM T3.date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id INNER JOIN account AS T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T4.account_id = T3.account_id GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY total_transactions DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many different banks are involved in transactions on account number 789?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bank) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 789

question: What percentage of all atoms are hydrogen atoms?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM atom AS T1

question: What is the ratio of accounts opened in Prague compared to other districts?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.a3 = 'Prague' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / SUM(1) AS prague_ratio FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id

question: Find the maximum score among posts that have more than 10 comments and less than 500 views.
sql: SELECT MAX(score) FROM posts WHERE commentcount > 10 AND viewcount < 500

question: Calculate the total sum of transactions for each district where the transaction type was 'VYDAJ' (withdrawal).
sql: SELECT T2.a2, SUM(T3.amount) as total_withdrawals FROM district AS T2 INNER JOIN account AS T1 ON T2.district_id = T1.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY T2.a2

question: Which accounts had the highest loan amounts in 1998?
sql: SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 1998 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the titles of the top 5 highest-voted posts.
sql: SELECT Title FROM posts ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many distinct clients used gold cards issued after 1998?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T4.client_id) AS distinct_clients FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.disp_id = T3.disp_id INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T3.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3.client_id = T4.client_id WHERE T1.type = 'gold' AND T1.issued > '1998-12-31'

question: Calculate the maximum view count of posts owned by users with a reputation greater than 1000.
sql: SELECT MAX(posts.ViewCount) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.Reputation > 1000

question: What is the average payment amount per loan?
sql: SELECT AVG(payments) FROM loan

question: What percentage of bonds involve at least one nitrogen atom?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'n' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T3.bond_id = T2.bond_id

question: What is the average score of posts that have received exactly 2 comments?
sql: SELECT AVG(score) FROM posts WHERE id IN (SELECT postid FROM comments GROUP BY postid HAVING COUNT(*) = 2)

question: What is the average score of posts that have been edited at least once?
sql: SELECT AVG(score) FROM posts WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT postid FROM posthistory)

question: Is molecule TR039 non-toxic?
sql: SELECT T.label FROM molecule AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR039'

question: How many distinct accounts have had transactions involving the keyword 'PREVOD NA UCET'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.account_id) FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET'

question: Identify the molecule with the most bonds of type '#'.
sql: SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the maximum amount of money spent by each client in a single transaction?
sql: SELECT T1.client_id, MAX(T2.amount) AS max_transaction_amount FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.account_id GROUP BY T1.client_id

question: What is the ratio of accounts with a high balance to those with a low balance?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN balance > 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN balance <= 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio FROM trans

question: What is the total number of loans taken out by clients in the city of Prague?
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T5.a3 = 'Prague' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_loans FROM client AS T4 INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T3.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN loan AS T1 ON T2.account_id = T1.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T5 ON T2.district_id = T5.district_id

question: What is the average loan amount for loans that were issued in 2018?
sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_loan_amount FROM loan WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2018

question: List all molecules that contain both hydrogen and chlorine atoms.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 WHERE T1.element IN ('h', 'cl') GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) = 2

question: Find the number of atoms per molecule and sort by the number of atoms.
sql: SELECT T1.molecule_id, T1.label, COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS num_atoms FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id GROUP BY T1.molecule_id, T1.label ORDER BY num_atoms

question: How many different elements are present in molecule TR005?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR005'

question: What is the total amount of money transferred out (VYDAJ) on account number 456?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id = 456 AND type = 'VYDAJ'

question: What percentage of clients are female owners of accounts?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.type = 'OWNER') * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)) AS percentage_female_owners FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id

question: What is the average number of votes per post in 2010?
sql: SELECT AVG(vote_count) AS avg_votes_per_post FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS vote_count FROM votes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creationdate) = 2010) AS subquery

question: How many different types of cards were issued to clients from the central Bohemia region?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.type) FROM card AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T4.a3 = 'central Bohemia'

question: What is the total balance of transactions for accounts opened in the year 1996?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T2.date) = 1996

question: Find all molecules that have exactly two carbon atoms and three hydrogen atoms.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' OR T1.element = 'h' GROUP BY T2.molecule_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 2 AND SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 3

question: What percentage of molecules with more than five atoms are labeled as negative?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 5)

question: Identify the top 4 users who have asked the most questions.
sql: SELECT U.DisplayName, COUNT(P.Id) AS QuestionCount FROM users AS U JOIN posts AS P ON U.Id = P.OwnerUserId WHERE P.PostTypeId = 1 GROUP BY U.Id ORDER BY QuestionCount DESC LIMIT 4

question: Which districts have had more than 100 accounts opened with a monthly statement fee?
sql: SELECT T3.a2 FROM account AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' GROUP BY T3.district_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100

question: Which user has received the most badges?
sql: SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM badges AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id GROUP BY T2.DisplayName ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Id) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of post links have a link type ID of 1 compared to those with a link type ID of 3?
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN linktypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN linktypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM postlinks

question: How many transactions over $1000 occurred in each year?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year, COUNT(*) as num_large_transactions FROM trans WHERE amount > 1000 GROUP BY year

question: What is the type of bond between atoms TR000_1 and TR000_2?
sql: SELECT T3.bond_type FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'

question: Among the molecules labeled as carcinogenic, how many atoms do they contain?
sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

question: What is the total amount of money transferred between accounts with IDs greater than 10000 and less than 20000?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans WHERE account_id BETWEEN 10000 AND 20000

question: What percentage of loans have a duration of more than 3 years?
sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE T1.duration > 36)::FLOAT * 100 / COUNT(*)) AS long_term_loans_percentage FROM loan AS T1

question: Which month had the highest number of transactions?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month, COUNT(*) as num_transactions FROM trans GROUP BY month ORDER BY num_transactions DESC LIMIT 1

question: Count the number of molecules with exactly three bonds of type '-'.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-' GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 3)

question: What is the average reputation of users who have posted more than 50 answers?
sql: SELECT AVG(T1.Reputation) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T2.PostTypeId = 2 GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING COUNT(T2.PostTypeId) > 50
